template.name: Landledger: incident cost to the room
template.description: When a Landfall incident ends, this flow reads the room's services and the window it was open, asks Landledger what those services cost over that window (estimated: a share of each day's cost, the services' spend while it was open, not what the incident added), and posts it in the room as a note with a link to Landledger's Explore, for the postmortem. Landfall knows nothing of Landledger: Landflow carries the figure, through the landfall plugin.

credentials.name: Landfall
credentials.description: Base URL, org slug and an lf_key_ API key (it reads rooms and posts the note as its member).

credentials.name: Landledger (read)
credentials.description: Landledger's API URL (in the cluster http://landledger-api.landflow-dev.svc.cluster.local:4810, on this machine http://127.0.0.1:4810) and an ll_ key with read.

setup: Pick or add **Landfall** (an `lf_key_` API key) and **Landledger (read)** (an `ll_` key with `read`).
In **Settings**, set `LANDLEDGER_CONSOLE_URL` for the Explore link, and `SERVICE_NAMES` where Landfall names a service differently from Landledger's Explore.

Publish: **Room ended** polls Landfall every minute. For each incident that ends, the flow posts "Pro-rated spend of these services during the incident (estimated), not the incident's extra cost: …" in its room, per service, with the window and a link to Explore; "No matching services: cost unknown" when Landledger knows none of them, never $0.00.

A window over the 1st of a month says how much falls on that day: Landledger charges invoice lines with no daily estimate on the 1st, so that share may be part of a month's invoice. A room open longer than 31 days is asked in 31-day parts and added up (a year at most).
The landfall plugin can't write a postmortem section, so the cost is a room note; the postmortem is written from the room. A room that names no service gets nothing.

workflow.name: Landledger: incident cost to the room
workflow.description: When a Landfall incident ends, this flow reads the room's services and the window it was open, asks Landledger what those services cost over that window (estimated: a share of each day's cost, the services' spend while it was open, not what the incident added), and posts it in the room as a note with a link to Landledger's Explore, for the postmortem. Landfall knows nothing of Landledger: Landflow carries the figure, through the landfall plugin.

nodes.name: Room ended
nodes.notes: Polls Landfall: an incident seen open that now has an ended status (resolved, closed, mitigated, recovered, done, archived), once.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.notes: Landledger's console URL, which entity kinds are services, Landfall → Landledger service names.

nodes.name: Cost of the window
nodes.notes: Cost → Window: each day's cost of the services, by the share of the day inside the window; always estimated. Landledger answers at most 31 days a call: the node asks a longer window in 31-day parts (at most 12) and adds them up.

nodes.name: Post it in the room
nodes.notes: A note (chat.message) in the room, as the member who owns the Landfall key. The landfall plugin has no postmortem operation, so the cost goes in the room's timeline, where the postmortem is written from.

nodes.name: No service named: nothing to cost
nodes.notes: The room names no service (no alert entity, attached entity or service: hint), or its window is empty.
